title: sieve_admin: /metrics endpoint is unauthenticated on non-loopback binding
description: sieve_admin.rs run_admin_server: /metrics is explicitly placed outside the bearer-token middleware so that Prometheus can scrape it without credentials. This is documented. However, when the admin endpoint is bound to a non-loopback address (allowed with allow_non_loopback=true or bearer_token set), /metrics exposes relay queue depths, peer names (via label values in relay_peer_up, relay_attempts_total etc), and message counts — which can reveal infrastructure topology. The fail-closed check in start_sieve_admin_server only blocks non-loopback without both a token and allow_non_loopback; but even with a token configured, /metrics bypasses the check. Operators who enable non-loopback binding expecting full authentication protection on the port will find /metrics wide open. This should be documented prominently or /metrics should support optional authentication.
